Worse than bad canteen food
Nov 2024 • Friends
Our hotel recommended us the Yummi a few meters away. We were the first guests at 7pm for four and wondered about it, but were really hungry. 
The spring rolls as a starter were very delicious and we relaxed. What followed were three clear meals, each with rice or fries with fried chicken egg without any taste, leafy unmade salad and fries cold and fatty. 
The worst was vegetarian rice as the main course. We don't know what kind of ringed oil was used. It was probably the same age as the last review. It smelled bad and tasted like it.
Unfortunately, the service after consultation with the owner ultimately did not care. 
We pay normally and this time decided to rate someone, albeit very negatively.

Great value restaurant
Mar 2024 • Couples
There are two "yummy" restaurants in Cat Ba. Yummy 1 and yummy 2. We ate at yummy 1 for two nights. No fuss, basic place that was nearly full each night, despite being the low season. The food was cheap, plentiful, simple and delicious. We had fried tofu, nems and pad thai. Pork with lemongrass and rice, plus the delicious nems again on the next night. Hanoi beer was only 20,000 dong ($1.30 AU). Total cost for the night was a crazy $10.50 AU including drinks. Please note, the place is not glamorous but we were there for the food, not the furniture. It is not on the seafront, so priced accordingly. Can recommend
Written March 4, 2024
